pe_file.description: Path to the PE file (PE32/PE32+ executable or DLL) to analyze.

output_format.description: Output format. One of: text, csv, xml, html.

headers.description: List of specific headers to display. Valid items: dos, coff, optional. If empty, uses default full output behavior if other flags not set.

show_imports.description: If true, add -i/--imports flag to show imported functions.

show_exports.description: If true, add -e/--exports flag to show exported functions.

show_dirs.description: If true, add -d/--dirs flag to show data directories.

show_all_headers.description: If true, add -H/--all-headers flag to show all PE headers.

show_all_sections.description: If true, add -S/--all-sections flag to show PE section headers.

full_output.description: If true, add -A/--all flag for full output.
